summary: Iteration 67 — Mahnwesen (RemindersSubtab) tab in Buchhaltung: verified backend GET /api/accounting/reminders/candidates returns 4 enriched candidates (all fields present); verified frontend renders new 'Mahnwesen' subtab (BellRing icon) between 'Rechnungen' and 'Ausgaben' with correct data-testid='accounting-subtab-reminders'. Container 'reminders-subtab' shows 5 KPI cards (Offen=4, Ohne=4, 1./2./3.=0/0/0, >30 T=4, Betrag=CHF 415.00), 6 filter chips with live counts, 4 rows all red-tinted (>=30 days). Bulk button disabled with 0 selection, enabled after selection; toggle-all selects all 4; only 1 row has an email (Stefan Haas RE-2026-0150) so 3 rows have disabled checkbox+Mahnen button (correct). Quick-paid modal opens with today's date (2026-09-29) pre-filled; quick-reminder modal loads preview (to=s.haas@auto-hinwil.ch, subject/body prefilled, fee=0 for level 1), switching to level 3 triggers new POST /reminder/preview and fee updates to 40 (from business settings). All 7 existing subtabs (overview/monthly/invoices/expenses/accounts/income/direct) still render without errors. No actual reminders sent (SMTP not configured, all modals cancelled).

issues: React hydration warning: <span> child inside <option> in expense-new-account select (AccountingPage.jsx L1015). Warning only – functionally fine. Comes from dev-instrumentation injecting a wrapper span into every dynamic child; harmless in production but should be cleaned up eventually.

critical_code_review_comments: RemindersSubtab useEffect for level preview has `level` in dep array but sets `level` inside — first render passes level=null → server picks next_level. Level re-clicks trigger correct re-preview. Good.
bulkSend loops sequential POSTs with await — safe against server overload but slow for large lists; acceptable given expected volume (<20 candidates).
open_amount computes price*(1+mwst/100) + reminder_fee_chf; matches backend definition. Consistent.
quick-paid-modal: `paid_at: date || today` fallback covers edge case of cleared date input. Good.
seed_data_creation: None. Existing 4 overdue invoices used read-only. All modals cancelled without state changes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mahnwesen tab is production-ready UI-wise. Only 1 of 4 seeded overdue invoices has a student_email (Stefan Haas / RE-2026-0150) — the other 3 (TEST_it39 Inv/Doc) are correctly rendered with disabled checkbox+Mahnen and 'keine E-Mail' badge.
